subject: Discovery call recap & rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Legrand <sophie.legrand@acme-eu.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery call recap & rotating demo slots

Hi Sophie 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap of what we covered and next steps so we're aligned: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for predictable, multiregion inference on open models (low latency for EU users + APAC pilots).
- Success metrics: p95 latency <150ms for core API, 20%+ cost improvement vs current infra, and auditability (logs/KMS).
- Scope: initial POC focused on 2 models, guidance on quantization, and a demo of routing/fallback.

Next step: schedule the technical demo / deep dive with your infra and platform folks. Because your team spans EU and APAC, I recommend a rotating set of recurring demo slots (so the same people aren't always early/late). Proposed approach below.

Proposed rotation (3-week cycle):
1) Week A: EU-friendly (11:00 CET / 02:00 PST / 19:00 JST)
2) Week B: US-friendly (09:00 PST / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST next day)
3) Week C: APAC-friendly (08:00 JST / 16:00 CET / 23:00 PST previous day)

I attached a one-page recap of the discovery and a preliminary .ics with the rotating slots (rotating_slots_v1.ics). I also added a Calendly link if you prefer to pick a single slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-45

Can you confirm: 1) who should be on the demo (roles/emails), and 2) if the rotating cadence above looks reasonable? If you want, I can send an initial recurring invite that rotates using separate events (keeps invites simple).

Thanks 
I've CC'd Marissa (solutions) to join the demo for the architecture deep dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Discovery_Recap.pdf, rotating_slots_v1.ics

From: Sophie Legrand <sophie.legrand@acme-eu.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Kenji Tanaka <kenji.tanaka@kyotoai.jp>
Date: 2027-02-25T17:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & rotating demo slots

Camila 

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposed rotation. That aligns with how we'd like to run the POC. A few quick notes:

- Attendees: I'll bring our platform lead (myself), Kenji (APAC infra), and our security lead (Clara; I'll add if needed).
- Preferences: EU team prefers mid-morning CET for our demos, Kenji will need APAC-friendly times once every 3 weeks.
- Calendar: a rotating schedule works well. If you can include the exact local times for each attendee in the invite that'd be helpful.

I've looped in Kenji to confirm APAC availability and to suggest any tweaks. If it's easier, send a sample 3-week calendar and we'll confirm slots.

Thanks 
Sophie Legrand
Platform Lead | Acme Energy
sophie.legrand@acme-eu.com

Thanks Sophie (and Kenji) 

Appreciate the quick reply. I created an initial sample 3-week schedule and attached the .ics (rotating_slots_v1.ics). Summary of the events I added: 

- Week A (EU-friendly): Tue 2027-03-02 11:00 CET (Sophie, Clara) 

— Redwood: Camila + Marissa
- Week B (US-friendly): Tue 2027-03-09 09:00 PST (Tom/US infra) 
— Redwood: Camila + Aditya
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Tue 2027-03-16 08:00 JST (Kenji + APAC infra) 
— Redwood: Marissa + Aditya

Notes: 
- I listed attendees by role; please reply with the exact emails to include in each event.
- If you prefer fewer changes, we can run Week A twice before rotating — happy to accommodate.
- Aditya (SE) is looped in for the deep architecture walkthrough — he can capture any configuration asks before the POC.

If this looks good I'll send the recurring invites (three separate events, one for each week/time) so local times display correctly for attendees. Otherwise I can also set up a single rotating event if you prefer to manage it centrally.

Best,
Camila

Attachments: rotating_slots_v1.ics
